stimulation.Description: Site targeted by continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS) immediately before this scan session. Site order was counterbalanced across subjects.

Levels.baseline: No stimulation. Session 1 is the pre-TMS baseline session used for numerosity-PRF mapping and baseline behaviour.
Levels.ips: cTBS over the individually localized numerosity-tuned right intraparietal sulcus (experimental site).
